acceptanceCriteria: A focused test proves a V1-1162 hop reference in a .vue, a .svelte and a markup file.
body:
Source: w6 appmap-impact lane report (2026-10-11), branch claude/w6-appmap-impact 31fb799d8.

Observed: hop references are proven only by a JS/TS lexer, so markup, .vue and .svelte files cannot prove V1-1162 hop references.

Expected: per-format lexers prove hop references in those files.
title: Per-format lexers to prove V1-1162 hop references in markup, .vue and .svelte files
